subject: math
cluster: Classify two-dimensional figures into categories based on their properties

items.prompt:
Order most general to most specific:
A) quadrilateral, rectangle, square
B) square, rectangle, quadrilateral
C) rectangle, square, quadrilateral
D) square, quadrilateral, rectangle

Is a square a quadrilateral, rectangle, and rhombus at once?
A) Yes
B) No
C) Only a rectangle
D) Only a rhombus

Which is more specific?
A) a square
B) a parallelogram
C) a quadrilateral
D) they are equal

A quadrilateral with two pairs of parallel sides and four right angles, with sides not all equal, is a
A) rectangle
B) square
C) triangle
D) rhombus

A $4$-sided shape with no parallel sides is a parallelogram?
A) Yes
B) No
C) Always
D) Only tilted ones

Which is more general?
A) parallelogram
B) rhombus
C) square
D) they are equal

A rectangle with all sides equal is a
A) square
B) triangle
C) circle
D) trapezoid

Order most general to most specific:
A) quadrilateral, parallelogram, rhombus
B) rhombus, parallelogram, quadrilateral
C) parallelogram, rhombus, quadrilateral
D) rhombus, quadrilateral, parallelogram
